title: Manage classes on an industry participant and promoter registration
summary: If you hold an industry participant and promoter registration, you can apply online to add or change classes to your existing registration.
intro:
If you hold an industry participant and promoter registration, you can apply online to add class(es) to your registration.

Any class that you add, or change will expire on the same registration expiry date as your existing registration classes.

If you need to surrender a registration or class, you’ll need to complete the form to Surrender a combat sports class or registration.
who_can_apply: Must be aged 18 years or over if applying for promoter, manager, or matchmaker registration classes.

how_to_steps.text: Gather the required details and documents.
Log in to your MyServiceNSW Account.
Follow the prompts to manage class(es) on your industry participant and promoter registration.

more_info.text: You'll get an industry participant identity card which will be mailed to your postal address within 10 business days.

Applications for promoter, manager and matchmaker are referred to the Commission of Police for a security determination. This may take several weeks. Promoters must allow enough time for their application to be considered. It is an offence to arrange a combat sport contest unless registered in the appropriate promoter class.
If you need to update your details (address, email, phone number), go to Change name or contact details on an industry participant and promoter registration.
To check your industry participant and promoter registration number and details, visit Verify NSW.

faqs.q: What happens to the expiry date of added or changed classes?
faqs.a: Any class you add or change will expire on the same registration expiry date as your existing registration classes.
